limitations: Not complete upload or indexing speed; fixed CPU-preprocessed pixels; 44 frames from 11 videos, no full-library quality regression.
Official SDPA and compilation are separate variants, never simultaneously enabled. Inductor itself fused 12 attention layers; the gains are not additive.
Only the isolated torch214 runtime removed incompatible torchaudio 2.8 (not used by this OWLv2 test); production runtime and Qwen were untouched.
Memory figures are sampled over four frames at 50ms intervals after empty_cache, not an exact hardware peak; RSS and MPS measurements overlap.
First two-frame compilation timing includes execution and graph compilation, not pure compiler time. The first torch214 run used a fresh compiler cache directory.
